observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 190.» (L19) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 52: 30 stands in the space between «CAPUT LII.» and the title, 35 beside L32.
body L28-L31: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT LII.» is centred, the title is set as a paragraph of three lines, the second and the third indented.
body L7, L32: the letters of the references (e) and (a) are bold italic; with chapter 52 the letters begin again at a.
body L5-L6: the article of «al–fard» is divided between the lines with the dash repeated at the head of L6, as on p. 120.
body L4: a speck stands after the comma of «tertiae,»; it is not a sign.
body L14: a speck stands in the right margin beside the line; it is not a sign.
body L20: the hyphen of «ascen-» is printed short and round (2.0 pt), like a point at the height of a hyphen.
body L14, L17: the dash of «’l–qarnayn» is 5.9 pt long in L14 and 4.7 pt in L17, both longer than the hyphens of the page (2.5–3.0 pt).
body L21: the e of «cognosces» is printed broken, like c, and a speck stands over it; it is not an accent.
body L26, L27: specks stand under the l of «stellae,» and under the space between «cum» and «Sole»; they are not signs.

body L29, L32, L33: a speck stands at the foot of the line before «quod» in the title; a speck stands between «Dicit» and «[auctor]»; the two n of «anno» are printed blotted, with a stray mark across them. They are not signs.
body L29: a small speck stands after «dicunt,» at the height of a hyphen; it is not a dash.
notes_left L3, L9: specks stand before «(2)» and after «Cod. 349.»; they are not signs.
notes_right L1, L8: a speck stands after «Cod. 8.»; it is not a sign. The closing parenthesis of «(13)» is printed short.

notes_right L9: the hyphen of «aṭ-ṭilsamāt» (3.7 pt) is a little longer than the other hyphens of the notes (2.6–3.1 pt) and shorter than the dash between the page numbers of note 13 (4.6 pt); it is kept as a hyphen. The kappa of «ἀποτελεσματικοί» is printed in the curly form (ϰ).

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
